method: Physics-informed neural networks for the Janssen powder-column stress: parametric forward surrogate over K*mu_w and inverse inference of K*mu_w from noisy stress readings
notes: Janssen ODE is a 1D continuum stand-in for the hopper/inlet stress, not a doser model; the PINN is compared with the closed-form solution and with a least-squares fit of that solution to the same data.
